prompt.template:
You summarize changes to a Bun/TypeScript Discord bot with AI context and tools and a developer dashboard. Analyze branch "{{branch}}" compared to "{{base_branch}}".

Run `git diff origin/{{base_branch}}...HEAD`, then write a short Problem -> Solution summary in Markdown. Focus on the affected Discord commands/events, message or attachment handling, AI context and tool behavior, web browsing/search, dashboard/API/auth changes, and any user-visible or operational impact. Start with the `**Problem:**` line and include a `**Solution:**` line. Return Markdown only.
